title: Crispy Roast Potatoes
desc: Fluffy potatoes with crisp, golden edges.
steps: Preheat to 200°C fan. Cut potatoes into equal large chunks.
Cover with water, bring to a boil and simmer for 8 minutes. Drain well and shake to roughen the edges.
Heat oil in a roasting tray for 5 minutes. Carefully add potatoes and turn to coat; season with salt and pepper.
Roast in a single layer for 45–55 minutes, turning twice, until deeply golden and crisp.

title: Mashed Potatoes
desc: Smooth potatoes with warm milk and butter.
steps: Cover potatoes with cold water in a saucepan and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 15–20 minutes until very tender; drain and let steam dry for 2 minutes.
Warm milk with butter until the butter melts.
Mash the potatoes by hand and fold in warm milk, butter, salt and pepper; do not blend in a food processor.

title: Potato Gratin
desc: Thin potato slices baked in cream and cheese.
steps: Preheat to 170°C fan. Slice potatoes evenly about 3 mm thick.
Simmer cream, milk, garlic, salt and nutmeg in a large pan. Add potatoes and cook gently for 5 minutes, stirring carefully.
Butter a deep 20 × 30 cm dish for the base batch. Transfer potatoes and all the cream mixture; scatter with Gruyère.
Bake for 50–60 minutes until a knife passes easily through the potatoes. Rest for 10 minutes.

title: French Fries
desc: Twice-fried potatoes with a crisp finish.
steps: Cut potatoes into even chips, rinse in cold water and dry thoroughly.
Heat oil to 140°C in a heavy pan no more than half full.
Fry in batches for 6–8 minutes until soft but pale; drain and cool for 10 minutes.
Raise oil to 180°C and fry again for 2–3 minutes until golden and crisp. Drain, season with salt and serve immediately.

title: Garlic Bread
desc: Warm bread filled with garlic butter.
steps: Preheat to 180°C fan.
Cut thick slices into the loaf without cutting through the bottom crust.
Spread the prepared garlic butter between the slices and wrap the loaf in foil.
Bake for 15 minutes, then open the foil and bake for 5 minutes more until crisp and hot.

title: Roasted Vegetables
steps: Preheat to 200°C fan and prepare large roasting trays.
Cut vegetables into similar bite-sized pieces.
Toss with oil, salt, pepper and thyme. Spread in one layer with space between pieces.
Roast for 30–40 minutes, turning halfway, until tender with browned edges.

title: Glazed Carrots
desc: Tender carrots in a butter and honey glaze.
steps: Put carrots, water, butter, honey and salt in a wide saucepan.
Bring to a simmer, cover and cook for 10 minutes.
Uncover and cook for 5–8 minutes until carrots are tender and the liquid forms a glaze.
Toss to coat, scatter with parsley and serve.

title: Creamed Spinach
desc: Chopped spinach in a rich cream sauce.
steps: Blanch spinach in boiling water for 1 minute. Drain, squeeze very dry and chop.
Soften onion in butter for 5 minutes.
Stir in flour for 1 minute, then add cream and simmer gently for 3 minutes.
Fold in spinach, salt and nutmeg and heat through for 2 minutes.

title: Green Beans with Garlic
desc: Tender green beans tossed with garlic butter.
steps: Boil green beans in water for 4–6 minutes until just tender.
Drain thoroughly.
Melt butter in a frying pan and cook garlic for 30 seconds without browning.
Add beans, salt and lemon juice; toss for 1 minute and serve.

title: Corn on the Cob
desc: Simply boiled corn with butter and salt.
steps: Remove any remaining silk from the corn.
Bring enough water to cover the cobs to a boil in a large pan.
Add corn and simmer for 6–8 minutes until tender.
Drain, spread with butter and season with salt.

title: Onion Rings
desc: Onion rings in a crisp, light batter.
steps: Separate onion slices into rings and pat dry.
Dust with the flour for coating. Whisk batter flour, baking powder, salt, egg and milk into a smooth batter.
Heat oil to 175°C in a heavy pan no more than half full.
Dip rings in batter and fry in small batches for 2–3 minutes, turning, until golden and cooked through. Drain on a rack and serve.

title: Simple Couscous
desc: Fluffy couscous with lemon and parsley.
steps: Put couscous, olive oil and salt in a heatproof bowl.
Bring the prepared vegetable stock to a boil and pour over the couscous.
Cover tightly and leave for 5 minutes until the liquid is absorbed.
Fluff with a fork and stir in lemon juice and parsley.
